features: Vibrant Display: Features a 6.7-inch HD+ PLS LCD screen with a sleek water-drop notch for immersive viewing
description: The Samsung Galaxy F07 in fresh Green colour is a budget‐friendly smartphone that doesn’t compromise on essentials. It packs a 50 MP dual rear camera setup (wide + depth) and an 8 MP front camera, letting you capture sharp daytime photos and decent selfies. The handset features a 6.7‐inch HD+ PLS LCD display with a water‐drop notch, giving you a large view for media, social media and casual gaming. Under the hood you get 4 GB RAM and 64 GB of internal storage (expandable via microSD), enough for everyday apps and media. With a long‐lasting 5000 mAh battery and support for 25W fast charging, you can stay unplugged longer and juice up faster. Designed slim at ~7.6 mm thickness and weighing ~184 g, it’s comfortable to hold. Software is handled by Samsung’s One UI over Android, with added perks like a side‐fingerprint sensor, dust/splash resistance (IP54) and modern connectivity options. All in all, the Galaxy F07 delivers good value – balancing display, battery, camera and build in a stylish, budget‐aware package.
